description: Which open tickets (not state:done) fit a capacity, such as a sprint's: by weighted priority, each ticket with its open blockers (blocks, depends-on) scheduled before it, and skipped when they don't fit together; filling goes on with smaller tickets further down. Returns the tickets in the order to work on them (a pulled-in blocker names the tickets it is for), used and remaining capacity, and the higher-ranked tickets that didn't fit with what they need. Nothing is written; tag the plan with tag_assign.

capacity.description: The capacity, in the unit of effort

effort.description: What a ticket takes from the capacity: its estimate (default) or its cost, estimate + risk

excludeTags.description: Don't plan tickets with any of these tags (e.g. state:wip); they are still pulled in as blockers. Each as prefix:value

tag.description: Only plan tickets with this tag (prefix:value); blockers are pulled in from anywhere

tags.description: Only plan tickets with all of these tags (intersection, also with tag). Each as prefix:value

name: plan_capacity

skipped.description: Tickets ranked above the last one planned that didn't fit

needs.description: Its effort with its unplanned blockers

tickets.description: In the order to work on them

for.description: For a blocker pulled in: the tickets it has to come before

rank.description: Rank among the open tickets in scope; null for a blocker from outside it (or excluded)
